disclaimer: Synthetic demonstration form, not an official insurance document.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your full legal name as printed on the identity document the form asks for.
what_to_enter.hi: Jo pehchan patra form maangta hai, usi par chhapa poora kanooni naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Form keluva gurutina dakhalealli iruva poorna kanoonu hesaranu baredi.

why_needed.en: Identifies the person named on the demo policy.
why_needed.hi: Demo policy par naam ke liye.

what_to_enter.en: Copy the policy number exactly as printed on the policy schedule.
what_to_enter.hi: Policy schedule par chhapa number vaise hi likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Policy schedulealli iruva numberannu nijavagiyu baredi.

why_needed.en: The office matches this form to a policy record.
why_needed.hi: Form ko policy se jodne ke liye.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the full name of the person you want to name as nominee, if the form asks for one.
what_to_enter.hi: Yadi form maange to nominee ke roop mein jis vyakti ka naam dena chahte hain, unka poora naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Form kelidare nominee aagi hesaru needabekada vyaktiya poorna hesaranu baredi.

why_needed.en: A nominee is the person named to receive proceeds if the account holder dies. This is general guidance, not legal advice.
why_needed.hi: Nominee vah vyakti hai jiska naam aap aapatkal ke liye dete hain. Yeh kanooni salah nahi hai.
why_needed.kn: Nominee endare khateya malika illadiddare hesaru kottiruva vyakti. Idu kanoonu salahe alla.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the relationship printed on the options, such as Spouse or Parent.
what_to_enter.hi: Spouse ya Parent jaise chhape vikalp mein se sambandh likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Spouse athava Parent haage mudrisida sambandha baredi.

why_needed.en: The form records how the nominee is related.
why_needed.hi: Nominee ka rishta darj karne ke liye.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the share percentage the form asks for, using numbers only.
what_to_enter.hi: Jo hisse ki pratishat form maange, keval ank likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Form keluva palada pratisatavannu sankhyegala maatra baredi.

why_needed.en: Some demo forms split a benefit across nominees.
why_needed.hi: Kuch demo form hisse baantte hain.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.
what_to_enter.hi: Apni janm tithi DD/MM/YYYY praroop mein likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Nimma janma dinankavannu DD/MM/YYYY svaroopadalli baredi.

why_needed.en: Used on this demo form as a nominee identifier.
why_needed.hi: Yeh demo form par nominee pehchan ke liye.

what_to_enter.en: Leave this blank in FormSathi. Sign the official paper form by hand.
what_to_enter.hi: Yahan FormSathi mein kuch na likhen. Asli form par haath se hastakshar karen.
what_to_enter.kn: FormSathiyalli idannu khali bidi. Adhikrita formnalli kaiyinda sahi maadi.

why_needed.en: A handwritten signature belongs only on the official paper.
why_needed.hi: Hastakshar sirf asli kagaz par likhen.
